title: Phone app: notifications when the Assistant has something to say

requirements.text: While the app is in the background, it stays connected to the relay through a foreground service and posts an Android notification for each new Assistant reply
Tapping the notification opens the app's Talk screen showing the reply
requirements.check: eye: TJ taps a notification on the phone

requirements.text: Replies already notified are not notified again after a reconnect, and the chat still shows them when the app opens
requirements.check: file: Watch.kt keeps its own notifiedUpTo and never writes lastSeen

requirements.text: The app asks for notification permission on Android 13+ and builds
TJ gets a notification on the phone when Tally replies while the app is closed
requirements.check: eye: TJ, phone locked, laptop prompt to Tally -> notification

text: Foreground service holding the relay socket, not Firebase push
breaks: Needs a permanent 'Genlock is listening' notification and some battery; true push needs a Firebase project TJ would set up

evidence: emulator Pixel_5_API_33 headless + fake laptop on a throwaway relay room (revoked after): app home -> reply sent -> dumpsys notification shows channel=replies title Tally text 'Sent while the app is in the background'; reply while on screen -> 0 notifications

emulator Pixel_5_API_33 headless + fake laptop on a throwaway relay room (revoked after): tapped notification 'Background reply two' -> MainActivity top, chat shows On screen reply / Background reply one / two, Tally is ready, notifications cleared

emulator Pixel_5_API_33 headless + fake laptop on a throwaway relay room (revoked after): wifi+data off 8s then on, Watch reconnected (hellos 106->107), notifications stayed 1, next reply made 2; on-screen reply not re-notified after HOME; chat still showed all replies on open
assembleDebug ok; manifest POST_NOTIFICATIONS + FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING; AskForNotifications requests on SDK 33+

text: Watch hangs up while the app is on screen: the relay keeps one phone socket per room (index.js 'a new one replaces the old'), so Link and Watch knocked each other off every ~2s (23 hellos in 40s). After fix: 0 extra hellos over 30s foreground and 30s background

Built and emulator-tested (Watch.kt foreground service, remoteMessaging). Only req 5 left: TJ's eye on the real phone with Tally. Needs the build on the phone: blocked on R2 setup (T-9YDCN) or adb install.
